title: Theo and the Colony
author: Emrys Hartwell
blurb: Hazel Eastwick, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
